title: Derived coherator triangle on an elementary distinguished square
statement:
Work in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme]. Use algebraic spaces over $S$, their small etale structure sheaves [def-trf-algebraic-space], the equivalent small ringed models [def-sfb-space-small-ringed-model], module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $(U\subset W,p:V\to W)$ be an elementary distinguished square in the sense spelled out in [lem-sfb-space-qcqs-distinguished-square-induction]: $U$ is open in $W$, $p$ is representable etale, and $V\times_WZ\to Z$ is an isomorphism for the reduced closed complement $Z=W\setminus U$. Put $T=U\times_W V$ and suppose $W,U,V,T$ are quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Here quasi-compactness means admitting a quasi-compact scheme etale atlas, and quasi-separatedness means having quasi-compact absolute diagonal. Write $j_A:A\to W$ for $A=U,V,T$, and $E_A=j_A^*E$ for exact etale restriction of $E\in D(\mathcal O_W)$ [lem-sfb-space-derived-etale-chart-calculus]. Let $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}$ denote objects with quasi-coherent cohomology [def-trf-space-quasi-coherent-module], and let $DQ_A$ and $DQ_W$ be the right adjoints of their full inclusions [lem-sfb-space-derived-coherator-adjunction]. Let $Rj_{A,*}$ derive canonical module direct image [def-trf-space-etale-module-functors], computed by K-injective resolutions [def-pur-kinjective-complex]. There is a distinguished triangle in $D(\mathcal O_W)$, natural in $E$,
$$DQ_W E\longrightarrow Rj_{U,*}DQ_U(E_U)\oplus Rj_{V,*}DQ_V(E_V)\longrightarrow Rj_{T,*}DQ_T(E_T)\longrightarrow (DQ_W E)[1].$$
The displayed $DQ$ objects are viewed in the ambient derived categories by the full inclusions. No boundedness or quasi-coherence of $E$ is assumed.

proof.text: For each $A=U,V,T$, the quasi-compact atlas in the hypotheses implies quasi-compactness of $|A|$ by the continuous-surjection assertion of [lem-a1-space-finite-affine-subatlas]; likewise for $W$. Thus [lem-sfb-space-qcqs-permanence] applies to $j_A:A\to W$ and makes it quasi-compact and quasi-separated. By [lem-sfb-space-derived-coherator-adjunction] all four inclusions $I_A,I_W$ have triangulated right adjoints $DQ_A,DQ_W$. Write $Q_Z=D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_Z)$ and suppress full inclusions when viewing objects in the ambient categories.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-space-relative-mv-exchange-triangles] with $f=\mathrm{id}_W$ and $K=E$. The unital derived-image comparison of [lem-sfb-space-derived-etale-chart-calculus] identifies $R(\mathrm{id}_W)_*$ with the identity. This gives the natural distinguished triangle $E\xrightarrow{a}B\xrightarrow{b}C\xrightarrow{\delta}E[1]$, where $B=Rj_{U,*}E_U\oplus Rj_{V,*}E_V$ and $C=Rj_{T,*}E_T$. Its first map has the two restriction components and its second is the difference of restrictions. This application is to the unbounded module derived categories, and requires no quasi-coherence of $E$.

source.place: Tag 08GW (lemma-exact-sequence-j-star), part (2), equivalently Tag 08JK (lemma-unbounded-relative-mayer-vietoris) for the identity morphism.

proof.text: Apply the triangulated functor $DQ_W$ of [lem-sfb-space-derived-coherator-adjunction] to this triangle, and then the inclusion of the full triangulated subcategory $Q_W$. By [def-weil-triangulated-category] the result is distinguished in $D(\mathcal O_W)$. Denote its last arrow by $d=\sigma_E\circ DQ_W(\delta)$, where $\sigma_E:DQ_W(E[1])\simeq(DQ_WE)[1]$ is the exact shift comparison. Additivity gives the canonical biproduct identification $DQ_WB\simeq DQ_WRj_{U,*}E_U\oplus DQ_WRj_{V,*}E_V$: the images of the inclusions and projections still satisfy the biproduct identities $p_i i_j=\delta_{ij}$ and $i_1p_1+i_2p_2=1$.

source.place: Tag 0CR6 (remark-explain-consequence), apply the exact functor DQ; Tag 0CR4 (lemma-better-coherator).

proof.text: Fix $j=j_A$ and write $Rj_*^q:Q_A\to Q_W$ for the restriction of $Rj_*$, which exists by [lem-sfb-space-derived-pushforward-coproducts] and step 1. Exact etale restriction $j^*$ preserves quasi-coherent cohomology and is left adjoint to $Rj_*$ by [lem-sfb-space-derived-etale-chart-calculus]. For $P\in Q_W$ and $L\in D(\mathcal O_A)$ the two coherator adjunctions give the natural chain $$\operatorname{Hom}_{Q_W}(P,DQ_WRj_*L)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal O_W)}(I_WP,Rj_*L)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal O_A)}(j^*I_WP,L)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{Q_A}(j^*P,DQ_AL)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{Q_W}(P,Rj_*^qDQ_AL).$$ Here the last bijection uses fullness and the same pullback/direct-image adjunction on quasi-coherent objects. Consequently both $DQ_WRj_*$ and $Rj_*^qDQ_A$ are right adjoint to $j^*I_W:Q_W\to D(\mathcal O_A)$. The uniqueness theorem [det-sp-unique-right-adjoint] supplies their natural counit-compatible isomorphism $\theta_A:DQ_WRj_*\simeq Rj_*^qDQ_A$. This is just composition of the cited Hom bijections, not an additional geometric base-change assertion.

source.place: Tag 0CR5 (lemma-pushforward-better-coherator), proof: both composites are right adjoint to the same restricted derived pullback.

proof.text: Let $B^q=Rj_{U,*}DQ_UE_U\oplus Rj_{V,*}DQ_VE_V$ and $C^q=Rj_{T,*}DQ_TE_T$. Combine the biproduct identification of step 3 with $\theta_U(E_U)\oplus\theta_V(E_V)$ to obtain $u:DQ_WB\simeq B^q$, and put $v=\theta_T(E_T):DQ_WC\simeq C^q$. Give the displayed triangle the arrows $u\circ DQ_W(a)$, $v\circ DQ_W(b)\circ u^{-1}$, and $d\circ v^{-1}$. The maps $(1,u,v)$ then form an isomorphism from the distinguished triangle of step 3 to this triangle: all three squares commute by cancellation of the inverse isomorphisms. It is distinguished by (TR1) of [def-weil-triangulated-category]. These arrows are natural in $E$: the original triangle, the functor $DQ_W$, its biproduct comparison, its shift comparison and the three $\theta_A$ are all natural. This proves the asserted triangle for arbitrary unbounded $E$.
